subject: general
question: Which of the following is an advantage of foreign competition?

options.text: No requirement to develop new products

solution:
The correct answer is __**Incentive to produce efficiently.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Foreign Competition:-**

 
 
• **It can be a powerful incentive for domestic firms to produce more efficiently.**
 
• In order to compete with foreign firms, domestic firms must find ways to lower their costs and produce
